findings.title: Blocked child turns are re-sent to the model as history on the next turn
findings.scenario: Child says «how to make a bomb» (prefilter) or any input-moderation/self-harm-blocked text → the User row is stored with SafetyFlag.Blocked (ChatService.cs:1835, 1877, 1526) → next innocent turn: Step 6 (ChatService.cs:2040) loads the last 20 rows via GetRecentMessagesAsync, which has no SafetyFlag filter → the blocked text (plus the canned reply) is sent to the model as conversation context; the model can pick the topic back up.
findings.evidence: ConversationService.cs:81-92 projects m.Role/m.Content with no SafetyFlag predicate; ChatService.cs:1835-1836, 1877-1878, 1526-1528 persist Blocked user rows; ChatService.cs:2040 history = GetRecentMessagesAsync(conversation.Id).
findings.fix: In GetRecentMessagesAsync (or a dedicated model-history query) add .Where(m => m.SafetyFlag != SafetyFlag.Blocked); leave dashboard projections unchanged.

findings.title: Fidelity retry (10c-sexto) overwrites a safety fallback installed by 10c-quater / rejected-retry, skipping the latin_run recheck
findings.scenario: Story turn with explicit choice. Reply has latin_run; 10c-bis retry still has latin_run (or retry is moderation-rejected) → 10c-quater (2683-2698) / rejected branch (2648-2660) set aiResponse = SafetyFallback, safetyFlag=Flagged, choices cleared. The outer `if (safetyFlag != Flagged)` at 2488 was evaluated ONCE; 10c-sexto at 2723 only checks choiceLabel. IsMissingReference(label, fallback) is true for most labels → a THIRD model call runs with the fallback as history → if moderation passes, aiResponse = fidelityResp, choices re-populated, stored Flagged. Child hears un-rechecked model prose (possibly Latin again).
findings.evidence: ChatService.cs:2488-2489 outer guard; 2648-2660 and 2683-2698 set Flagged+fallback inside it; 2723 condition has no safetyFlag check; 2788 closes the outer block; ContinuationFidelity.cs:26-36.
findings.fix: Add `&& safetyFlag != SafetyFlag.Flagged` to the 10c-sexto condition (and 10c-quinto).

findings.title: SecrecyPromiseGuard runs only on the first model reply; quality/fidelity retries bypass it
findings.scenario: Primary reply triggers a quality retry or fidelity retry → retry text is moderated (moderation does not catch secrecy promises) and adopted at 2640 / ~2770 without IsSecrecyPromise → child can hear «this stays between us» on any retried turn.
findings.evidence: SecrecyPromiseGuard referenced only at ChatService.cs:2215-2218 (Step 8.9); retry adoption at 2503→2640 and 2737→~2770 have no guard call.
findings.fix: Apply SecrecyPromiseGuard to retryRaw/fidelityRaw before moderation (mirror Step 8.9), or once more right before Step 11.

findings.title: Usage:Tiers:Enabled=true silently disables the fleet-wide kill switch (OpenAI:DailyCostCap:Global)
findings.scenario: Operator flips the tiers flag → the Global ceiling check lives only inside `else if (costCapOpts.Enabled)` on all three gate sites → no fleet ceiling while tiers are on.
findings.evidence: ChatController.cs:127-172; AudioChatController.cs:562-604; StoryQaController.cs:195-215 and 828-842; UsageTiersOptions has no Global.
findings.fix: Evaluate the Global cap before the tier branch, independent of the flag.

findings.title: Per-child mode override never applies on the toy's voice path (childId: null)
findings.scenario: Device Game=on, default child override Game=false → manifest tells the toy Game is off, but the child says «խաղանք» by voice → audio gate checks device flags only → Game runs. Inverse: device off, child on → toy offers Game, voice gate refuses with the mode-disabled clip.
findings.evidence: AudioChatController.cs:217-218 IsModeEnabledForRequestAsync(deviceId, childId: null, …) and :554; DeviceService.cs:659-661; ChatService.cs:1803-1806 resolves the default child for the same request.
findings.fix: In the audio gate resolve the default child for the device and pass its id.

findings.title: Parent's mode switch is enforced only on trigger messages; continuation turns bypass it for up to 30 min
findings.scenario: Parent turns Game off while a session is live → child's next answer («շուն») has no trigger → gate's single-message ModeDetector returns None → Allow → ChatService continues Game/Riddle from ActiveModes, or Story from PendingChoices.
findings.fix: After the resolved detectedMode is known (after Step 7a), re-check IsModeEnabledForRequestAsync and return the ModeDisabled canned reply.

findings.title: Dangerous-input prefilter stores its canned reply as Clean; the moderation-block path stores the same kind of reply as Flagged
findings.scenario: Prefilter block → assistant fallback row SafetyFlag.Clean; input-moderation block → identical fallback row Flagged. Parent sees the prefilter fallback as an ordinary toy reply.
findings.fix: Store the prefilter fallback with SafetyFlag.Flagged.

findings.title: N17 round-undo snapshot is taken after the turn directive already mutated the round
findings.scenario: Riddle reveal/hint turn or Game continue mutates the round in Step 7 (2178-2185); snapshot at 2270 is post-directive; empty model reply → ApplyEmptyReplyFallback restores to the POST-directive state → child never heard the reveal/hint but the round is gone / a hint is charged.

findings.title: StoryMemories is never reset when a new story starts
findings.scenario: Story A ends; within 30 min child says «ուրիշ հեքիաթ պատմիր» → Step 7a-bis injects story A's memory; Merge keeps old fields → new story pulled back to the old cast/place.
findings.evidence: ChatService.cs:2124-2137; 2258-2262; StoryMemoryParser.cs:92-103; no TryRemove on StoryMemories outside the sweep.
findings.fix: TryRemove StoryMemories when Story is detected by explicit trigger with no live pending choice.

findings.title: TurnEnded=true whenever a new_game/switch_game reply lacks a valid GAME_TYPE tail — the toy proposes a game and stops listening
findings.scenario: Model omits the tail block or emits an off-taxonomy type on a new_game turn → no CurrentRound → TurnEnded=true → X-Areg-Turn-End → firmware ends the voice session right after the game invitation.
findings.evidence: ChatService.cs:2896-2899; 2320-2321; GameLoopIntegrationTests pins only Stop→true and tail-present→false.
findings.fix: Set TurnEnded from the Stop intent decided in BuildGameTurnDirective instead of inferring from CurrentRound absence.

findings.title: Chat/audio cost cap uses the under-counting estimator overload
findings.scenario: Every /api/chat and /api/chat/audio turn estimates from userMessage+reply only; system prompt, history and extra model calls ignored; a $0.25 cap permits several times that in real spend.
findings.evidence: ChatController.cs:184-185; AudioChatController.cs:297; OpenAICostEstimator.cs:77 doc; StoryQaController.cs:603 uses FromPrompt.
findings.fix: Return prompt chars + model-call count on ChatResponse and use EstimateChatCostUsdFromPrompt.

findings.title: Usage allowance and 'questions today' are UTC-day; the rest of the dashboard's today is device-local
findings.scenario: Yerevan: allowance resets at 04:00 local; dashboard shows two different 'today's.
findings.fix: Document, or key DeviceUsageDay by the device's local date.

findings.title: Cancellation contract text says 'nothing stored' but the child's row is stored before the cancellable model call
findings.scenario: Toy drops during the model call → User row from Step 3 stays with no reply → orphan child line on the dashboard and in the next turn's history.
findings.evidence: ChatService.cs:1788-1797 comment, 1889 store, 2199/2228 cancellable calls; ChatServiceCancellationTests.cs:164-178.
findings.fix: Fix the comments/CLAUDE.md to 'no assistant row'.

findings.title: Sentence cap, typo fixes and Calm/Curiosity punctuation rewrites run after output moderation
findings.scenario: 4+-sentence reply where the safety caveat is the 4th → EnforceMaxSentences cuts it after moderation approved the full text; meaning/caveat loss, not a bypass.
findings.fix: Accept and document, or apply the cap before Step 9 and after each adopted retry.

findings.title: Moderation adapter reads only 5 of omni-moderation's parent categories; illicit / illicit/violent are ignored
findings.scenario: omni-moderation-latest flags «how to make a bomb» as illicit/violent, not violence → adapter maps sexual/violence/self-harm/hate/harassment only → IsSafe=true → only the keyword DangerousInputFilter stands.
findings.fix: Map Illicit / IllicitViolent (and SelfHarmIntent/Instructions → self-harm) into flagged if the SDK exposes them.

findings.title: Library playback advances before output moderation / cancellation can end the turn
findings.scenario: Continue cue → Advance() moves the tracker → toy drops during moderation → nothing stored, but the position already moved; next continue serves the following segment.
findings.fix: Peek first, moderate, then Advance; or accept and document.
